a: Isolate tenants by schema, row-level security, or separate databases.
One DB, schema per tenant balances isolation and operational cost.
RLS enforces tenant_id filters in the database layer.
Resolve tenant from subdomain, header, or token claims early.
Quotas and rate limits prevent one tenant from starving others.
Feature flags and settings should be tenant-scoped.
Export and delete tenant data on cancellation per policy.
Meter usage per tenant for seats, API calls, or storage.
Map customer domains with TLS certificates automatically.
Provide tenant-level admin distinct from platform superadmin.
